description: This file defines the Proxy class which provides static methods to create composite request handlers for Guzzle HTTP client, enabling request wrapping based on synchronous or streaming behavior.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Provides static methods to create wrapped request handlers for synchronous and streaming contexts within Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: wrapSync
methods.description: Creates a handler that directs requests to a default handler or a sync handler based on the 'synchronous' option.

methods.name: wrapStreaming
methods.description: Creates a handler that directs requests to a default handler or a streaming handler based on the 'stream' option.
